items.t: Home Depot or Lowe’s: Which Dividend Grower Wins for Long-Term Income?
items.sum: Barron's just downgraded Lowe's to Sell, yet the cheaper stock boasts faster dividend hikes and a fatter cushion. With housing stuck in a slump, retirees must decide which payout deserves their trust. The answer splits three ways.

items.t: Lowe’s Stock Cut to Sell as It Struggles to Catch Up to Home Depot
items.sum: Stifel warns of margin pressure and costly investments as Lowe’s tries to catch up to Home Depot’s contractor business.

items.t: Stifel downgrades Lowe’s to Sell, stays cautious on Home Depot ahead of earnings
items.sum: Investing.com -- Stifel has downgraded Lowe’s (NYSE:LOW) to Sell from Hold ahead of the home improvement retailer’s fiscal third-quarter results next week, with the firm also taking a cautious stance on Home Depot (NYSE:HD).

items.t: Unveiling Lowe's (LOW) Q3 Outlook: Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
items.sum: Besides Wall Street's top-and-bottom-line estimates for Lowe's (LOW), review projections for some of its key metrics to gain a deeper understanding of how the company might have fared during the quarter ended October 2026.

items.t: LOW Stock Gets Fresh Analyst Downgrade Ahead Of Q3 Earnings – What Investors Need To Know
items.sum: Stifel downgraded Lowe's to 'Sell' from 'Hold' and lowered its price target to $190 from $195, according to The Fly.

items.t: Stifel Downgrades Lowe's Companies to Sell, Lowers Price Target to $190
items.sum: Stifel analyst W. Andrew Carter downgrades Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) from Hold to Sell and lowers the price target from $195 to $190.
